name: Linktree
whatYouLose: The linktr.ee domain that audiences already recognize
prompt:
Build a link-in-bio page generator, a Linktree replacement.

Stack: Astro static site, content in a single links.json file.
Features:
- One page: avatar, name, short bio, a vertical stack of link buttons, social icon row.
- 6 themes via CSS variables (including dark, paper, neon); theme chosen in links.json.
- Privacy-friendly click counts: each button hits /go/:id on a tiny serverless function that increments a counter and redirects.
- Open Graph image auto-generated from the name and avatar.
- Lighthouse 100 across the board; no client JS except for the counter link.
Done when: editing links.json and redeploying to any static host updates the page.
notes: It is a single HTML page. This is the canonical "you do not need a subscription for this" example.
